_README: Per-scenario deterministic specs for spec_task.py. SEALED: `behaviours` run against the workspace but are never written into it, so a session cannot satisfy a check by editing the check. Locked by sha256 in task-bank-lock.json before any run; spec_task.py refuses to grade if the hash has moved. Every behaviour declares a `kind`: a `discriminator` MUST fail on the pristine fixture and MUST pass on the solved reference under tests/evals/e2e/solutions/<id>/; a `guard` is a regression check that MUST pass on both. mutation_controls.py / discrim.py assert both directions -- a one-directional check cannot tell a working discriminator apart from one that can never match.

SC-22.label: security finding
SC-22.task: The order-lookup helpers build SQL by interpolating caller-supplied values into the query string. Fix the injection risk.

behaviours.name: no_fstring_interpolation_in_sql
behaviours.code:
import inspect, re, store
src = inspect.getsource(store)
bad = re.findall(r'f["\x27][^\n]*\{', src)
assert not bad, f'f-string interpolation still present: {bad}'

SC-10.label: PostgreSQL migration
SC-10.task: Every lookup filters orders by status and placed_at, and there is no index for it. Add the migration that creates one.

behaviours.name: index_migration_exists
behaviours.code:
import pathlib, re
sql = '\n'.join(p.read_text() for p in pathlib.Path('migrations').glob('*.sql'))
assert re.search(r'CREATE\s+INDEX', sql, re.I), 'no CREATE INDEX in any migration'
assert re.search(r'status', sql, re.I), 'index does not mention the status column'

behaviours.name: original_migration_still_creates_table
behaviours.code:
import pathlib, re
sql = pathlib.Path('migrations/0001_create_orders.sql').read_text()
assert re.search(r'CREATE\s+TABLE', sql, re.I)
